about: Electrode positions used by the v0 Zarr store's channel sets (hours, datasets, buckets) and by the channel sets the v1 store adds to v0 (added_*), derived from the converter's position bank (REVE's public bank and MNE's BioSemi-160/256 templates; coordinates in metres, head-centred, x right, y anterior, z up, rounded to 1e-4 m); case-fold spellings sharing a coordinate are merged. 'unplaced' lists the channel names the bank lacks, which the converter placed from their dataset's own coordinates (not drawn). Generated by docs/plot_corpus/sync_data.py, do not hand-edit.
